_readme: Each cluster groups issues that are true duplicates of each other (same underlying bug/request, different wording). Clusters of size 1 are genuinely unique issues that must NOT be flagged as duplicates. This starter set is hand-authored to exercise paraphrasing, template boilerplate, and topical-but-different issues; replace/extend with real mined issues from your target repo for a production-representative number.

issues.title: App crashes immediately on launch
issues.body: Every time I open the app it crashes within 1-2 seconds. No error dialog, just closes. Happens on every launch since updating to v2.3.0.

issues.title: Crash on startup after update
issues.body:
### Steps to reproduce
1. Update to latest version
2. Open the app

Expected: app opens.
Actual: app closes instantly, no error shown. Started after upgrading to 2.3.0.

issues.title: Application closes right after opening it
issues.body: Opening the app results in an immediate crash. Nothing in the logs. Reproducible 100% of the time on my machine, started right after the last update.

issues.title: Memory usage keeps growing during long sessions
issues.body: If I leave the app open for a few hours, memory usage climbs from ~200MB to over 2GB. Doesn't seem to plateau. Have to restart the app periodically.

issues.title: Possible memory leak after extended use
issues.body:
```
RSS: 210MB -> 1.9GB over 3 hours
```
No obvious trigger, just grows steadily the longer the app stays open. Restarting fixes it temporarily.

issues.title: RAM consumption increases over time and never goes down
issues.body: Noticed the app's memory footprint keeps increasing the longer it runs, even when idle. Eventually gets slow and I have to restart it.

issues.title: App becomes sluggish after hours of use due to memory growth
issues.body: Performance degrades the longer the app has been open, and I can see in Activity Monitor that memory usage is steadily climbing without ever coming back down.

issues.title: Cannot log in with correct credentials
issues.body: I'm entering the right username and password but I keep getting 'invalid credentials'. Tried resetting my password, same issue.

issues.title: Login fails even with valid username/password
issues.body:
### Environment
Browser: Chrome

Steps: enter correct email + password, click login. Result: 'invalid credentials' error even though I just reset the password and confirmed it works via the reset email flow.

issues.title: Getting 'invalid credentials' error on login despite correct password
issues.body: Password is definitely correct (just reset it), but the login form still rejects it with an invalid credentials message.

issues.title: Exported CSV has garbled special characters
issues.body: When I export data containing accented characters (é, ñ, etc.) to CSV, they show up as mojibake (Ã©, Ã±) when opened in Excel.

issues.title: CSV export encoding issue with non-ASCII characters
issues.body: Non-English characters get corrupted in the exported CSV file. Looks like an encoding mismatch, possibly missing a UTF-8 BOM for Excel compatibility.

issues.title: Pagination shows duplicate rows on page 2
issues.body: Going to page 2 of the results table shows some of the same rows that were already on page 1.

issues.title: Some records appear twice when paginating
issues.body:
### Steps
1. Go to list view
2. Navigate to next page

A handful of rows from page 1 also appear on page 2. Looks like an off-by-one issue in the pagination offset.

issues.title: Please add a dark mode / theme option
issues.body: Would love a dark theme for late-night usage. Currently the bright white background is hard on the eyes.

issues.title: Feature request: dark theme support
issues.body: Many users have asked for this — a dark mode toggle in settings would be great, especially for OLED screens and low-light environments.

issues.title: Search is extremely slow with large datasets
issues.body: Searching in a workspace with 100k+ items takes 10-15 seconds to return results. Feels like a full table scan rather than using an index.

issues.title: Search query performance degrades badly at scale
issues.body: Tested search on a large dataset (~100k records) and response times are unacceptably slow, several seconds per query. Might need an index on the search column.

issues.title: Typo in installation docs
issues.body: The Quickstart page says 'pip instal' instead of 'pip install'. Minor but confusing for first-time users copy-pasting the command.

issues.title: API rate limits are not documented
issues.body: Couldn't find anywhere in the docs what the actual request-per-minute limit is for the public API. Had to find out by hitting a 429.

issues.title: Webhooks are not retried on failure
issues.body: If our endpoint returns a 500 or times out, the webhook delivery is not retried at all — we just silently miss the event. Would like at least a few retries with backoff.

issues.title: Exporting more than 50k rows times out
issues.body: When exporting a dataset with over 50,000 rows to CSV, the request just times out after 30s instead of streaming the file or running as a background job.

issues.title: Sidebar overlaps content on small screens
issues.body: On mobile viewports (<400px wide) the sidebar doesn't collapse and overlaps the main content area, making it unreadable.

issues.title: Mobile view: sidebar covers page content
issues.body: On my phone (iPhone SE size screen), the navigation sidebar stays open and sits on top of the page content instead of collapsing into a hamburger menu.

issues.title: Timestamps shown in UTC instead of local timezone
issues.body: All dates/times in the dashboard are displayed in UTC regardless of my profile's timezone setting. Expected them to be converted to local time.

issues.title: Dashboard dates don't respect user timezone setting
issues.body: I set my timezone to EST in settings, but every timestamp on the dashboard still shows UTC. Seems like the timezone setting isn't actually applied to the display layer.

issues.title: How do I get an invoice with our company's VAT number on it?
issues.body: We need our VAT number included on invoices for accounting purposes. Is there a way to add this to our billing profile?

issues.title: Support SAML SSO for enterprise accounts
issues.body: Our IT department requires SAML-based single sign-on for any tool we adopt. Is this on the roadmap?
